executive.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
executive.description: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

executive.title: SK Hynix bargains for chip equipment exports to its China facility in return for building a factory in US
executive.description: SK Hynix’s Solidigm is reportedly seeking U.S. approval to send more chipmaking equipment to China as it weighs building a new NAND chip factory in America.

executive.title: Automattic begins layoffs following board upheaval and executive departures
executive.description: Sources say more cuts could follow as the company looks to improve its finances.

executive.title: Surveillance company Flock cuts staff as privacy backlash grows
executive.description: Flock would not say if CEO Garrett Langley would take a pay cut following the reduction in workforce.

executive.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
executive.description: A running look — in reverse chronological order — at the bigger tech companies that have announced significant layoffs this year with AI as a stated factor.

executive.title: Lucid Motors’ new CEO cuts 18% of staff to ‘simplify the company’
executive.description: The company is also eliminating a production shift at its Arizona factory to align "production plans with anticipated demand."

executive.title: Robinhood’s note on 10% layoffs shows blaming AI isn’t cutting it
executive.description: Unlike many of his tech industry peers who have cut thousands of jobs citing the need to restructure  to make the most of AI, Robinhood's CEO Vlad Tenev conspicuously made no mention of AI in his note

executive.title: Tech CEOs are apparently suffering from AI psychosis
executive.description: "CEOs are uniquely prone to AI psychosis," Box CEO Aaron Levie opines. Maybe that explains the almost religious belief in AI productivity gains.

executive.title: Intuit to lay off over 3,000 employees to refocus on AI
executive.description: In a memo to employees, CEO Sasan Goodarzi said the layoffs are meant to reduce complexity, simplify the company's corporate structure, and deliver better AI products.

executive.title: Cisco cuts nearly 4,000 jobs to spend more on AI, reports ‘record quarterly revenue’
executive.description: This is Cisco's latest layoff in recent years, while the company's chief executive touts record revenue and growth.

funding.title: Scimplify raises $25M to challenge China’s grip on critical materials with AI
funding.description: Scimplify's annualized revenue run rate has tripled to $200 million as it eyes U.S. expansion.

funding.title: Cloudflare acquires Deno to improve its Workers programming model
funding.description: Cloudflare will use this acquisition to improve its Workers programming model and platform.

funding.title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
funding.description: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain and Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents.

funding.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
funding.description: The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.

funding.title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B
funding.description: The manufacturing accelerator bills itself as "America’s answer to Shenzhen."

funding.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
funding.description: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

funding.title: VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product-market fit
funding.description: Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail, share the do's and don'ts for building hit products.

layoffs.title: AI was supposed to kill engineering jobs, but new data suggests they’re the most resilient
layoffs.description: While AI dominates the layoff narrative, engineers are actually making up a larger share of new hires, according to SignalFire data.

layoffs.title: As OpenAI files for IPO, Sam Altman’s eye-scanning company is doing layoffs, report says
layoffs.description: Tools for Humanity, Sam Altman's identity verification company, is reportedly struggling to generate revenue and will downsize its staff.

layoffs.title: GM just laid off hundreds of IT workers to hire those with stronger AI skills
layoffs.description: Some of the positions focus on AI-native development, data engineering and analytics, cloud-based engineering, and agent and model development as well as prompt engineering and new AI workflows.

layoffs.title: Truecaller slashes 70 jobs amid declining ad sales
layoffs.description: Truecaller's ad revenue declined by 44%, leading to the layoffs.
